# Bookmark Scope

> A Chrome bookmark extension (Manifest V3, with an experimental Firefox build) that shows the bookmarks you already have for the current page, host or domain, and provides a dashboard to clean duplicates, tag, check link health, and back up and restore. Local-first: no account, no server, no analytics.

Written against Bookmark Scope 5.1.0. Checked 2026-10-08. Source: https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Bookmark-Scope

## Get started

- [Quick start & first run](guides/quick-start.html): Install Bookmark Scope, pin it, see what is already saved for the site you are on, and open the dashboard. About ten minutes.
- [Installation](guides/installation.html): Install Bookmark Scope from the Chrome Web Store, load it unpacked, or try the experimental Firefox build. Pin it, update it, and remove it without losing your bookmarks.

## Everyday use

- [Popup](guides/popup.html): How the Bookmark Scope popup works: page, host and domain scope, URL matching, search with fuzzy fallback, quick actions, the toolbar badge and the right-click menu.
- [Dashboard tour](guides/dashboard-tour.html): A guided tour of the Bookmark Scope dashboard: header, filters, side panels, health score, grouping, selection, the detail panel and the virtual list.
- [Finding & searching](guides/finding-and-searching.html): Search operators, filters, tag chips, fuzzy fallback, and exactly how Bookmark Scope decides that two URLs are the same page, host or domain.
- [Organizing](guides/organizing.html): Tag bookmarks, bulk-change tags with a preview and undo, move bookmarks with drag and drop, and understand what Bookmark Scope can and cannot do with folders.
- [Cleaning up](guides/cleaning-up.html): How Bookmark Scope finds duplicates, untitled, old and title-colliding bookmarks, the duplicate preview with survivor choice, and exactly what delete and Undo can and cannot restore.

## Link health

- [Link health](guides/link-health.html): How Bookmark Scope checks whether bookmarked pages still load: statuses, the optional site-access permission, manual and resumable scans, scheduled background scans, redirect repair and the cache.
- [Review reminders & notifications](guides/review-reminders.html): Every notification Bookmark Scope can show, what triggers it, and how to set up review reminders.

## Saved work

- [Smart views](guides/smart-views.html): Save a search, filter, grouping and tag selection as a named view you can reopen with one click. Views store the recipe, never the bookmarks.
- [Backup & restore](guides/backup-and-restore.html): Snapshots, import (browser bookmarks.html files, Pocket, Pinboard, Raindrop, the built-in JSON and CSV formats and plain URL lists), export as JSON or CSV, recovery journals, and what cannot be restored.

## Reference

- [Command palette & shortcuts](guides/command-palette.html): The complete list of Bookmark Scope keyboard shortcuts and the searchable command palette, verified against the source.
- [Settings reference](guides/settings-reference.html): Every Bookmark Scope setting, its choices and default, plus the preferences that are remembered automatically.
- [Appearance & languages](guides/appearance-and-languages.html): Light, dark and system themes, four colour palettes, 52 interface languages including right-to-left layouts, and how translation coverage works.

## Trust and support

- [Privacy, permissions & data](guides/privacy-and-data.html): Which permissions Bookmark Scope asks for and why, what it stores on your device, and the only cases in which anything leaves your browser.
- [Diagnostics](guides/diagnostics.html): Download a privacy-filtered diagnostic file to attach to a bug report. See exactly what is in it before you save it.
- [Troubleshooting & FAQ](guides/troubleshooting-faq.html): Answers to common problems with Bookmark Scope: missing results, permission prompts, scans that stop, Undo, tags, languages and more.
- [Limits & known limitations](guides/limits.html): An honest list of what Bookmark Scope cannot do, hard limits, and behaviors that were found to be wrong or unfinished when this guide was written.
- [Privacy policy](privacy.html): The full privacy policy: what Bookmark Scope accesses, what it stores on your device, what leaves your browser, and how long data is kept. Same text as docs/PRIVACY.md in the repository.

## Notes for readers and tools

- Link health is the only feature that contacts third-party sites; it requires an optional host permission the user grants.
- Delete Undo cannot restore original bookmark IDs or dates added.
- Known unfinished or faulty behavior is listed in guides/limits.html.
